digest.component_or_area: type checking infrastructure and ratchet enforcement
propositions: Repository contains 146+ untyped function definitions and large numbers of explicit `Any` type annotations across 10+ packages, limiting type safety and testability.
The mypy ratchet enforcement mechanism currently only constrains untyped definitions but does not constrain explicit `Any` usage, allowing a backdoor to loose typing.

13 packages can be promoted to the `disallow_untyped_defs` ratchet tier and 2 additional packages can be elevated to a new `disallow_any_explicit` tier with only 36 targeted annotations and zero new `Any` introduction.

The ratchet promotion requires configuration updates in `pyproject.toml`, test enforcement in `test_mypy_ratchet.py` to prevent regression (shrink-only guards), and documentation in `architecture.md`.
